warm_A.interpretation: Whole-verifier context only. System CPU is interval utilization across logical CPUs including this benchmark; process cpu_core_percent is relative to one logical CPU and may exceed 100. The first CPU observation is excluded. Cumulative disk deltas cover only adjacent valid samples. PID/create_time changes, unavailable processes and counter resets are never bridged or filled with zero. Nominal 200ms polling includes acquisition and scheduling gaps; missing-periodic counts estimate skipped nominal slots. No per-query interpolation, process-specific slowdown causality, Ollama token speed or optimization claim follows. Observer work remains part of this measured environment.

resource_interpretation: Identical continuous 200ms target telemetry brackets every complete run; global run label/mode is separate from the frozen sampler slot zero. Start/end/non-overlap validated. Observer work can overlap timers. No CPU causation or Ollama GPU/token slowdown claim.
cost_interpretation: Fair-comparison primary = verification + append excluding nested commit + all chunk commits, including final flush commit. Rank is nested in verification. Setup/tail/entry are separate overlapping diagnostics. This differs from the V22 cell rollup per-query cost excluding direct budget publication.
